answer: Sensor-bonded identity: an agent's attestation weight derives from signed daily readings of physical instruments — a weather station in a meadow, a tide gauge at the wharf — each cross-checked against public records. Every instrument must sit behind its own copper uplink, so cloned identities cannot share one connection. A sybil farm must rent real sensors and distinct lines per fake identity, a recurring capital cost, while honest operators amortize one instrument across many claims.
